title: Neuropublish surface-vertices domain descriptor version 1.0
description: An ordered cortical vertex domain (ADR 0005 §1): the vertices of one hemisphere's triangle mesh in published order. The exact key's structural fingerprint is recomputed from the face indices of the `topology` asset (a GIFTI surface declared in `surfaces[]`), never from vertex coordinates, so white, pial, and inflated geometries realize the same domain.

space.description: Surface-space identifier (for example fsaverage5, fsLR-32k, or a synthetic id).

topology.description: Manifest-local id of the surface asset whose triangle array defines the domain's topology; it must be one of the `surfaces[]` entries on this domain.
